entities.name: Skophos
entities.description: The labyrinthine city-state of the minotaurs on Theros, a dark reflection of Akros.

entities.name: Akros
entities.description: A city-state whose soldiers face the minotaurs; founded alongside Skophos.

entities.name: Minotaurs
entities.description: The organized warriors and population of Skophos.

entities.name: Mogis
entities.description: God of war and chief deity of the minotaurs, brother of Iroas.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God of war, brother of Mogis and enemy of the minotaurs.

entities.name: Ephara
entities.description: A god worshipped only in the Lesser Peristyle of Skophos.

entities.name: Karametra
entities.description: A god whose ancient aspect requiring blood sacrifices is worshipped in Skophos.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: A god whose violent side has a temple in Skophos.

entities.name: Keranos
entities.description: A god whose violent side has a temple in Skophos.

entities.name: Purphoros
entities.description: A god whose violent side has a temple in Skophos.

entities.name: Thassa
entities.description: A god rarely recognized in Skophos.

entities.name: Lesser Peristyle
entities.description: The only temple that openly worships Ephara, a venue for minotaur debates.

entities.name: Mogis's Chalice
entities.description: The largest temple of Mogis at the center of Skophos and seat of government.

entities.name: Katachthon Mountains
entities.description: Mountains where humans and minotaurs fought.

entities.name: Birth of the Poleis
entities.description: The time humans waged war with the minotaurs.

entities.name: Haraksi
entities.description: A smith and priest of the Lesser Peristyle.

events.summary: During the Birth of the Poleis, humans war with the minotaurs in Phoberos and the Katachthon Mountains; Iroas and Mogis reportedly fight over the land, resulting in the founding of Akros and Skophos.
events.quote: This conflict resulted in the founding of Akros and Skophos
